entry.title: Hello, World!
entry.content:
Sometimes I have stuff to say that I’d want to send to other people etc, or otherwise just yap about, and I will do this here when I want to.

Not too sure how often I’ll end up posting or using it, but here it is anyways
Continue to About.

:root { color-scheme: dark; --bg: #111514; --text: #dce2da; --muted: #a7b2a7; --accent: #c4dc75; --line: #344039; }body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace; padding-top: 64px; }body::selection { color: var(--bg); background: var(--accent); }.container { max-width: 1170px; }.page, .post { font-family: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.85; }.content { padding-top: 28px; }a { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; }a:hover, a:focus { color: #e1efa8; text-decoration: underline; }a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }.navbar-inverse { background: #111514; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }.navbar-inverse .navbar-brand, .navbar-inverse .navbar-nav > li > a { color: var(--text); font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; }.navbar-inverse .navbar-brand { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; text-shadow: none; }.navbar { min-height: 52px; }.navbar-inverse .navbar-brand { height: 52px; padding: 16px 18px; line-height: 20px; }.navbar-inverse .navbar-nav > li > a { padding: 16px 14px; line-height: 20px; }.navbar-toggle { margin-top: 10px; }.navbar-inverse .navbar-nav > li > a:hover { color: var(--accent); }.page-header { border-color: var(--line); margin: 18px 0 20px; padding-bottom: 22px; }.page-header h1 { color: var(--text); font-size: clamp(28px, 5vw, 42px); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -1.5px; }.page-header.logo { background: none; margin-left: 0; margin-right: 0; }.page-header.logo > h1 { padding-left: 0; font-size: clamp(28px, 5vw, 42px); line-height: 1.4; }.navbar-toggle.navbar-header { margin-right: 15px; }.slogan { color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 24px; font-size: 14px; }.eyebrow { color: var(--accent); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1px; line-height: 1.7; }.home-intro { padding: 16px 0 38px; margin-bottom: 32px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }.home-intro h2 { font-size: clamp(25px, 4vw, 35px); line-height: 1.3; margin: 20px 0; letter-spacing: -1px; }.home-intro > p:not(.eyebrow) { max-width: 65ch; }.home-links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px 30px; font-size: 14px; margin-top: 24px; }.writing-empty { color: var(--muted); padding: 5px 0 24px; }.writing-empty h2 { color: var(--text); font-size: 22px; }.mypage { border-bottom-color: var(--line); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }.page .mypage > p, .page .mypage > ul, .page .mypage > ol { max-width: 85ch; }.mypage h2 { margin-top: 48px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--text); }.mypage h3 { margin-top: 30px; line-height: 1.4; }.mypage li { margin-bottom: 12px; }.mypage p { margin-bottom: 20px; }.mypage p a, .mypage li a { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #6d7a4c; text-underline-offset: 3px; }.mypage img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }.date, .meta-widget, footer { color: var(--muted); }.title, .widget h4 { font-family: inherit; }.alert-success { background: #1a221b; border-color: var(--line); color: var(--muted); border-radius: 0; }#sidebar { padding-left: 30px; font-size: 13px; }.widget { border-color: var(--line); margin-bottom: 28px; }.widget h4 { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; }input, .form-control, #local-search-input { background: #1b211d; color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; }#local-search-input { font-family: inherit; -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--text); padding: 7px 10px; height: auto; width: 100%; }#local-search-result { background: var(--bg); }p.search-result { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.7; }code { background: #222b23; color: #dde9b8; border-radius: 2px; }pre, .highlight { background: #0b0f0c; border-color: var(--line); color: var(--text); overflow-x: auto; max-width: 100%; }.highlight table { width: 100%; }.highlight .gutter { color: #839081; }blockquote { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; }.btn-default { background: #1b211d; color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--line); border-radius: 0; }.btn-default:hover { background: #273126; color: var(--text); border-color: var(--accent); }footer { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.8; padding: 32px 20px; }.blink-fast, .blink-slow { animation: none !important; color: var(--accent); }table { display: block; overflow-x: auto; }th, td { padding: 9px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }@media (max-width: 767px) { body { padding-top: 54px; } .content { margin: 0; padding: 14px 0; } .page, .post { font-size: 15px; } #sidebar { padding-left: 15px; margin-top: 35px; } .mypage h2 { font-size: 22px; } }@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }
